description: This file contains the implementation of the 'Setting' controller class within the 'Startup' namespace for OpenCart's catalog module. The class handles initialization tasks such as determining store URL, loading settings, configuring timezone, and output compression.

classes.name: Setting
classes.description: Controller class responsible for initializing store settings, specifying configurations for URL, timezone, and response compression during application startup.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that executes startup routines such as determining current store based on hostname, loading store settings, setting URL, timezone, and compression level.
